claim.value: Both sides of the localized boundary should be retested on matched workloads.

provenance.rationale: P025 explicitly proposes matched-workload retesting of both sides; P023 identifies the localized boundary.

signal_basis.value: Repeated confident revision classifications narrow the transition to a boundary associated with the defined tail-rate increase, without establishing a sole cause.
signal_basis.scope: Localization under valid endpoints, comparable trials and a persistent single transition; association is limited to tested conditions.

provenance.rationale: These spans supply the classification rule, interval narrowing, conditional localization and explicit limits on causal interpretation.
The proposed confirmatory retest is warranted by localization itself; no additional unresolved empirical relation is needed to license this follow-up.

rationale: A localized association warrants checking whether the contrast reproduces on matched workloads across the boundary. The claim recommends that check without asserting its outcome or claiming causality or deployment safety.
uncertainty: Whether retesting reproduces the contrast remains unknown; that uncertainty does not undermine the recommendation to retest.
